verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs describe continuous monitoring, alerts, and evidence collection maintaining audit readiness, with a dedicated Continuous Risk Monitoring dashboard, integration monitoring, and automated checks (e.g., access checks, framework health APIs) that surface issues via webhooks/integrations rather than only at annual audit. This directly matches the story of ongoing automated testing against connected systems with near-real-time surfacing of failures. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of actual detection latency (hours vs annual) and no third-party benchmark confirming alert speed.
